finding: no-foreign-reuse: gate-ui reuses a running server ONLY when fetchSentinelRoot(PORT_BASE) === own worktree root (serverIsThisWorktree); a foreign/absent sentinel forces pickBindablePort + own boot. Verified against TEST-4 + the K=2 sentinel-provenance probe.

FNV twin is byte-identical to Rust worktree_db: shared fixture '/data/pbya/ziee/tmp/xwt-a' → '12080097' asserted in BOTH the node test (TEST-3) and the Rust #[cfg(test)] cross_language_parity_fixture. A drift in either language goes red.

Torn-binary race closed by temp-write + fs::rename (atomic per POSIX) — the correctness mechanism; the per-binary flock is best-effort serialization only (documented). is_intact re-check under the lock avoids redundant re-writes. Proven by the 8-thread Barrier concurrent_extract_never_torn test (sha256-intact).

Every failure path (create/write/fsync/chmod/rename) removes the temp file and returns a context-carrying AppError — no silent let _ / unwrap on a real failure (CODING_GUIDELINES §6). flock acquire failure degrades to no-serialization (rename still guarantees no torn file), logged at debug.

Teardown is runId-scoped ONLY: kills only PIDs the harness spawned, removes only its own PROVE_RUNID docker (docker ps --filter name=$PROVE_RUNID) + its own throwaway worktrees. No broad docker/pkill/rm/prune anywhere — the harness obeys the rules it verifies (audit §9).

Reaper docker filter is session-namespaced (ziee-desktop-test-postgres-pg<base>-) so a session can only list/reap its OWN containers; liveness from the SHARED lock (collectLiveRunIds/shouldKeepContainer), not the invisible-to-siblings .test-configs. Cross-session clobber (tailtest twin) closed.

e2e app.data_dir is per-worktree per-test under <root>/.ziee-cache/e2e-app-data/<testId> (never ~/.ziee); the shared bin/ cache is symlinked read-only per-worktree. TEST-8 asserts the path never contains the home ~/.ziee. No cross-worktree write path.

pickBindablePort forward-search makes the dev port bind-verified before strictPort; TOCTOU window between the bind-check and vite's own bind is accepted (same documented caveat as allocatePostgresPort/isPortBindable). gate:ui/playwright pass --port on the CLI which overrides this path.

pickBindablePort tries up to 200 ports (span width); each is a sub-ms createServer bind. Negligible cost, bounded. worktreeKey shells `git rev-parse` once per config load (cached by resolveWorktreeRoot callers) — acceptable at config time.

Desktop bases derive from run-key PORT_FLOORS (desktopE2eBackend 9600 / desktopE2ePg 54600) OFF the web-e2e 9100/54331 overlap, lock dir keyed by worktreeKey(); mirrors the already-fixed web port-manager idiom. Env overrides still win (CI).

concurrent_extract_never_torn spawns 8 threads on a Barrier extracting a 512KB payload and asserts every reader sees the sha256-intact file — a real concurrency exercise, not a tautology (A4). torn_leftover_is_replaced + intact_file_is_not_rewritten cover the size-mismatch + no-op paths.
Port floors/spans live in a named PORT_FLOORS table (no inline magic numbers), documented per-harness; a retune is one central edit (DEC-4 rationale).

The run key is ONE mechanism in two languages (Rust worktree_db + Node run-key.mjs) that every resource derives from; no cross-module state threading. New helpers added in-place; existing worktree_key/should_auto_isolate untouched.

A new harness adds a PORT_FLOORS entry + a portWhich value; consumers resolve via resolveGalleryPort without edits. gallery.config port:null means 'derive' — an app may still pin an explicit port. Open seam, not a closed switch.

resolveGalleryPort precedence (explicit env > explicit cfg > key-derived) is obvious + documented; serverIsThisWorktree/fetchSentinelRoot return safe falsy defaults (never throw) so callers can't misuse them into a foreign-reuse.
No REST/route/response-type change in the whole diff; extract_atomic is an internal helper. No OpenAPI regen implied; emit_ts golden parity unaffected (BASE.md).
No user-facing permission introduced; the embedded extract path has no authz surface (build/runtime bin staging). A9/A10 N/A for this feature.

Harness learns each dev server's port by grepping the vite log for 'localhost:PORT'; if vite's log format changes or it binds IPv6-only, port detection could miss. Mitigation: fall back to scanning the key-derived port range for the /__worktree sentinel. FIXED in FIX_ROUND-1 (sentinel-scan fallback added).
All added strings are dev/test log lines (not user-facing); no 'ziee-chat' anywhere in the diff (CODING_GUIDELINES §17). grep confirms none.
No UI surface / component / render state added by the feature; a11y N/A (config + harness only). No new gallery cell → no state-matrix churn.
Per-test app.data_dir is created in the yaml step and removed in teardown (testId-scoped rmSync), so no per-run state leaks across tests; the shared read-only bin symlink is never deleted per-test.
